name: Public Contracts Law 182/2018 - limits on public works
standard: Public Contracts Law No. 182 of 2018; Executive Regulations, Minister of Finance Decree 692/2019
why_no_rules: The limits below are enforced by the contracts module on every public works contract (app.modules.contracts.public_procurement), not by a rule set this pack switches on. This document records the figures so the operator can read them.
scope_note: Applies to contracts of public bodies. A private owner's contract follows its own terms, usually FIDIC, and none of these limits bind it.
source_note: Consolidated English translation of the law and its Executive Regulations, Andersen Egypt, January 2026, read 2026-10-19. Each figure is also carried, with its note, in app.modules.contracts.public_procurement.PUBLIC_WORKS_LIMITS.
review_status: Provisional. Read from a translation, not the Arabic official gazette text. Pending review by an Egyptian lawyer or quantity surveyor.
regulator: Ministry of Finance (Central Agency for Public Procurement)
